package.title: Tokyo Tea Break
package.promised: A quiet, atmospheric pause in Tokyo centered on tea. I expect to see the setting and ritual of a Japanese tea break and come away with a feel for the experience.

new_things: Tokyo supposedly pulled back from financing American debt.
That pullback allegedly left Washington with a funding gap and raised borrowing costs.
Finance analysts blame deficits, consumer debt, or signals from Jackson Hole.

reports.promise_answered: not yet — I am still waiting to see a quiet Tokyo setting and the ritual or experience of a Japanese tea break.
